They include [[Troy (TV series)|Troy]] and [[Rex (TV series)|Rex]], as well as at least two others. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Trap]]=== Four sheriffs find [[the Ghoul]] in the [[Super Duper Mart (TV series)|Super Duper Mart]]. Two of them, Troy and Rex, arrest him and take him to meet President Booker; however, after this meeting with Booker, the Ghoul kills the two sheriffs. ==Appearances== The Govermint sheriffs appear only {{in|FOTV}}. {{FOTV appearances|4=104}} ==Gallery== Sheriff Troy.png|[[Troy (TV series)|Sheriff Troy]]
